namespace Dij

/-- Dijkstra search state: tentative distances (`none` = not yet reached) and settled flags. -/
structure St where
  dist : Array (Option Int)
  visited : Array Bool

def mkInit (n start : Nat) : St :=
  ⟨(Array.replicate n (none : Option Int)).setIfInBounds start (some 0),
   Array.replicate n false⟩

/-- Linear-scan extract-min over the frontier: unvisited nodes with a finite tentative
distance, among indices `< i`.  This is the priority queue of the dense Dijkstra variant. -/
def pickMinAux (s : St) : Nat → Option (Nat × Int) → Option (Nat × Int)
  | 0, acc => acc
  | i + 1, acc =>
      let acc' :=
        match s.dist.getD i none, s.visited.getD i false with
        | some d, false =>
            match acc with
            | none => some (i, d)
            | some (j, dj) => if d < dj then some (i, d) else some (j, dj)
        | _, _ => acc
      pickMinAux s i acc'

def pickMin (s : St) : Option (Nat × Int) := pickMinAux s s.dist.size none

def setVisited (s : St) (u : Nat) : St :=
  { s with visited := s.visited.setIfInBounds u true }

/-- Better of a tentative distance (`none` = ∞) and a new finite candidate. -/
def better (a : Option Int) (b : Int) : Option Int :=
  match a with
  | none => some b
  | some d => some (min d b)

/-- Relax a single outgoing edge `(v, w)` from a node whose settled distance is `du`. -/
def relaxEdge (du : Int) (s : St) (e : Nat × Int) : St :=
  { s with dist := s.dist.setIfInBounds e.1 (better (s.dist.getD e.1 none) (du + e.2)) }

def relax (g : WeightedGraph) (s : St) (u : Nat) (du : Int) : St :=
  ((g.adj.getD u #[]).toList).foldl (relaxEdge du) s

/-- Main settle loop, driven by explicit fuel (`graph.size` rounds suffice). -/
def loop (g : WeightedGraph) : Nat → St → St
  | 0, s => s
  | k + 1, s =>
      match pickMin s with
      | none => s
      | some (u, du) => loop g k (relax g (setVisited s u) u du)

end Dij

-- Main function definition
def dijkstra_shortest_paths (graph : WeightedGraph) (start : Nat)
    (h_precond : dijkstra_shortest_paths_precond graph start) : List (Option Int) :=
  -- !benchmark @start code
  (Dij.loop graph graph.size (Dij.mkInit graph.size start)).dist.toList

  -- !benchmark @end postcond

/-! ### Path plumbing (L2–L5): facts about `is_path` / `path_has_weight`. -/

/-- L2: in a simple graph an edge has a unique weight. -/
theorem edge_weight_unique {g : WeightedGraph} (hwf : g.well_formed)
    {u v : Nat} {w₁ w₂ : Int} (h₁ : g.has_edge u v w₁) (h₂ : g.has_edge u v w₂) : w₁ = w₂ := by
  obtain ⟨hu, p₁, hp₁, hp₁v, hp₁w⟩ := h₁
  obtain ⟨-, p₂, hp₂, hp₂v, hp₂w⟩ := h₂
  have := (hwf u hu).2 p₁ p₂ hp₁ hp₂ (by rw [hp₁v, hp₂v])
  rw [← hp₁w, ← hp₂w, this]

/-- L3: with non-negative weights every path weight is non-negative. -/
theorem path_weight_nonneg {g : WeightedGraph} (hnn : g.weights_non_negative) :
    ∀ (p : List Nat) (w : Int), g.path_has_weight p w → 0 ≤ w := by
  intro p
  induction p with
  | nil => intro w h; simp only [WeightedGraph.path_has_weight] at h; omega
  | cons u rest ih =>
    cases rest with
    | nil => intro w h; simp only [WeightedGraph.path_has_weight] at h; omega
    | cons v rest' =>
      intro w h
      simp only [WeightedGraph.path_has_weight] at h
      obtain ⟨we, wr, he, hr, rfl⟩ := h
      have h1 := hnn _ _ _ he
      have h2 := ih wr hr
      omega

theorem getD_append_left {p : List Nat} {i : Nat} (h : i < p.length) (v : Nat) :
    (p ++ [v]).getD i 0 = p.getD i 0 := by
  simp [List.getD_eq_getElem?_getD, List.getElem?_append_left h]

theorem getD_append_right (p : List Nat) (v : Nat) :
    (p ++ [v]).getD p.length 0 = v := by
  simp [List.getD_eq_getElem?_getD]

theorem getD_last_of_getLast? {p : List Nat} {u : Nat} (h : p.getLast? = some u) :
    p.getD (p.length - 1) 0 = u := by
  rw [List.getLast?_eq_getElem?] at h
  simp [List.getD_eq_getElem?_getD, h]

/-- L4: appending an edge to the end of a path yields a path. -/
theorem is_path_snoc {g : WeightedGraph} {p : List Nat} {u v : Nat} {w : Int}
    (hp : g.is_path p) (hlast : p.getLast? = some u) (he : g.has_edge u v w) :
    g.is_path (p ++ [v]) := by
  obtain ⟨hlen, hstep⟩ := hp
  refine ⟨by simp, ?_⟩
  intro i hi
  simp only [List.length_append, List.length_cons, List.length_nil] at hi
  rcases Nat.lt_or_ge (i + 1) p.length with hlt | hge
  · obtain ⟨w', hw'⟩ := hstep i hlt
    exact ⟨w', by rwa [getD_append_left (Nat.lt_of_succ_lt hlt),
      getD_append_left hlt]⟩
  · have hi' : i + 1 = p.length := by omega
    have hip : i < p.length := by omega
    refine ⟨w, ?_⟩
    rw [getD_append_left hip, hi', getD_append_right]
    have : i = p.length - 1 := by omega
    rw [this, getD_last_of_getLast? hlast]
    exact he

/-- L5: the weight of a path extended by one edge. -/
theorem path_has_weight_snoc {g : WeightedGraph} :
    ∀ (p : List Nat) {wp : Int} {u v : Nat} {w : Int},
      g.path_has_weight p wp → p.getLast? = some u → g.has_edge u v w →
      g.path_has_weight (p ++ [v]) (wp + w) := by
  intro p
  induction p with
  | nil => intro wp u v w _ hl _; simp at hl
  | cons a rest ih =>
    cases rest with
    | nil =>
      intro wp u v w hw hl he
      simp only [List.getLast?_singleton, Option.some.injEq] at hl
      subst hl
      simp only [WeightedGraph.path_has_weight] at hw
      subst hw
      exact ⟨w, 0, he, rfl, by omega⟩
    | cons b rest' =>
      intro wp u v w hw hl he
      simp only [WeightedGraph.path_has_weight] at hw
      obtain ⟨we, wr, hab, hrest, rfl⟩ := hw
      have hl' : (b :: rest').getLast? = some u := by
        rwa [List.getLast?_cons_cons] at hl
      have := ih hrest hl' he
      exact ⟨we, wr + w, hab, by simpa using this, by omega⟩

/-! ### State read-back layer (pass 4): `D`/`Vis` accessors and the `relax` read-back. -/

namespace Dij

/-- Tentative distance of `v` (`none` = ∞). -/
def D (s : St) (v : Nat) : Option Int := s.dist.getD v none

/-- Settled flag of `v`. -/
def Vis (s : St) (v : Nat) : Bool := s.visited.getD v false

theorem D_lt_size {s : St} {v : Nat} {d : Int} (h : D s v = some d) : v < s.dist.size := by
  by_contra hc
  simp [D, Array.getD, hc] at h

theorem getD_set_self {α : Type _} (a : Array α) (i : Nat) (x d : α) (h : i < a.size) :
    (a.setIfInBounds i x).getD i d = x := by
  simp [Array.getD, h]

theorem getD_oob {α : Type _} (a : Array α) (i : Nat) (d : α) (h : ¬ i < a.size) :
    a.getD i d = d := by
  simp [Array.getD, h]

theorem getD_set_ne {α : Type _} (a : Array α) (i j : Nat) (x d : α) (h : i ≠ j) :
    (a.setIfInBounds j x).getD i d = a.getD i d := by
  by_cases hb : i < a.size
  · have hb' : i < (a.setIfInBounds j x).size := by simpa using hb
    simp only [Array.getD, dif_pos hb, dif_pos hb']
    show (a.setIfInBounds j x)[i] = a[i]
    simp only [Array.setIfInBounds]
    split
    · first
        | simp [Array.getElem_set, Ne.symm h]
        | simp [Array.getElem_set, h]
        | exact Array.getElem_set_ne _ _ _ _ _ (Ne.symm h)
        | grind
    · rfl
  · rw [getD_oob _ _ _ (by simpa using hb), getD_oob _ _ _ hb]

@[simp] theorem Vis_relaxEdge (du : Int) (s : St) (e : Nat × Int) (v : Nat) :
    Vis (relaxEdge du s e) v = Vis s v := rfl

theorem better_le (a : Option Int) (b : Int) : ∃ c, better a b = some c ∧ c ≤ b := by
  cases a with
  | none => exact ⟨b, rfl, le_refl b⟩
  | some d => exact ⟨min d b, rfl, min_le_right d b⟩

theorem better_le_of_some {a : Option Int} {d : Int} (h : a = some d) (b : Int) :
    ∃ c, better a b = some c ∧ c ≤ d := by
  subst h; exact ⟨min d b, rfl, min_le_left d b⟩

theorem better_cases (a : Option Int) (b : Int) :
    better a b = a ∨ better a b = some b := by
  cases a with
  | none => exact Or.inr rfl
  | some d =>
    rcases le_total d b with hle | hle
    · exact Or.inl (by simp [better, min_eq_left hle])
    · exact Or.inr (by simp [better, min_eq_right hle])

/-- Read-back of a single relaxation step. -/
theorem D_relaxEdge (du : Int) (s : St) (e : Nat × Int) (v : Nat) :
    D (relaxEdge du s e) v =
      if v = e.1 ∧ v < s.dist.size then better (D s v) (du + e.2) else D s v := by
  by_cases hv : v = e.1
  · by_cases hb : v < s.dist.size
    · rw [if_pos ⟨hv, hb⟩]
      simp only [D, relaxEdge, hv]
      exact getD_set_self _ _ _ _ (hv ▸ hb)
    · rw [if_neg (by tauto)]
      simp only [D, relaxEdge]
      rw [getD_oob _ _ _ (by simpa using hb), getD_oob _ _ _ hb]
  · rw [if_neg (by tauto)]
    simp only [D, relaxEdge]
    exact getD_set_ne _ _ _ _ _ hv

/-- Every entry of `relaxEdge` is either unchanged or the freshly relaxed candidate. -/
theorem relaxEdge_cases (du : Int) (s : St) (e : Nat × Int) (v : Nat) :
    D (relaxEdge du s e) v = D s v ∨
      (v = e.1 ∧ D (relaxEdge du s e) v = some (du + e.2)) := by
  rw [D_relaxEdge]
  by_cases hc : v = e.1 ∧ v < s.dist.size
  · rw [if_pos hc]
    rcases better_cases (D s v) (du + e.2) with h | h
    · exact Or.inl h
    · exact Or.inr ⟨hc.1, h⟩
  · exact Or.inl (by rw [if_neg hc])

/-- `relaxEdge` never increases a distance. -/
theorem relaxEdge_mono {du : Int} {s : St} {e : Nat × Int} {v : Nat} {d : Int}
    (h : D s v = some d) : ∃ d', D (relaxEdge du s e) v = some d' ∧ d' ≤ d := by
  rw [D_relaxEdge]
  by_cases hc : v = e.1 ∧ v < s.dist.size
  · rw [if_pos hc]
    exact better_le_of_some h _
  · exact ⟨d, by rw [if_neg hc]; exact h, le_refl d⟩

/-- After relaxing edge `e`, its target satisfies the Bellman inequality for `e`. -/
theorem relaxEdge_target {du : Int} {s : St} {e : Nat × Int} (hb : e.1 < s.dist.size) :
    ∃ d, D (relaxEdge du s e) e.1 = some d ∧ d ≤ du + e.2 := by
  rw [D_relaxEdge, if_pos ⟨rfl, hb⟩]
  exact better_le _ _

@[simp] theorem Vis_foldl (du : Int) (l : List (Nat × Int)) (s : St) (v : Nat) :
    Vis (l.foldl (relaxEdge du) s) v = Vis s v := by
  induction l generalizing s with
  | nil => rfl
  | cons e es ih => simp [List.foldl_cons, ih]

theorem foldl_mono {du : Int} (l : List (Nat × Int)) {s : St} {v : Nat} {d : Int}
    (h : D s v = some d) : ∃ d', D (l.foldl (relaxEdge du) s) v = some d' ∧ d' ≤ d := by
  induction l generalizing s d with
  | nil => exact ⟨d, h, le_refl d⟩
  | cons e es ih =>
    obtain ⟨d1, h1, hle1⟩ := relaxEdge_mono (du := du) (e := e) h
    obtain ⟨d2, h2, hle2⟩ := ih h1
    exact ⟨d2, by simpa [List.foldl_cons] using h2, by omega⟩

theorem foldl_cases {du : Int} (l : List (Nat × Int)) (s : St) (v : Nat) :
    D (l.foldl (relaxEdge du) s) v = D s v ∨
      ∃ e ∈ l, v = e.1 ∧ D (l.foldl (relaxEdge du) s) v = some (du + e.2) := by
  induction l generalizing s with
  | nil => exact Or.inl rfl

    rw [List.foldl_cons]

      · exact Or.inr ⟨e, by simp, h2, by rw [h, h3]⟩
    · exact Or.inr ⟨e', by simp [he'], hv', hval⟩

    (he : e ∈ l) (hb : ∀ t : St, t.dist.size = s.dist.size → e.1 < t.dist.size) :
    ∃ d, D (l.foldl (relaxEdge du) s) e.1 = some d ∧ d ≤ du + e.2 := by
  induction l generalizing s with

    rw [List.foldl_cons]

end Dij
